params.name: response_type
params.description: `ecobeePin` for the PIN flow, or `code` for the authorization-code flow.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The application key (API key) for your application.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Redirect URI for the authorization-code flow.

params.name: state
params.description: Opaque value echoed back for the authorization-code flow.

items.docs: Starts an authorization flow. For the ecobee PIN flow, set `response_type=ecobeePin`; the response returns a PIN, an authorization `code`, and expiry, which the user enters in the ecobee web portal to grant access. For the authorization-code flow, set `response_type=code` with a `redirect_uri`. This endpoint is on the host root, not under /1.

params.name: code
params.description: The authorization code (for ecobeePin / authorization_code grants).

params.name: refresh_token
params.description: The refresh token (for the refresh_token grant).

params.name: client_id
params.description: The application key (API key) for your application.

params.name: ecobee_type
params.description: Set to `jwt` to have the API return access tokens as JWTs.

items.docs: Exchanges an authorization code for an access token and refresh token (`grant_type=ecobeePin` or `authorization_code`), or refreshes an expired access token (`grant_type=refresh_token`). Parameters are passed as query string. This endpoint is on the host root, not under /1.
